name: OpenBao Agent
description: Installs OpenBao and runs OpenBao Agent as an s6-overlay service.

version.description: OpenBao release version to install. `latest` installs the newest stable release with a Linux archive for the current architecture.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs OpenBao Agent. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.

configPath.description: Absolute path to the user-supplied OpenBao Agent configuration file.
